name: Lighthouse Ventures
decision_note: Prague early-stage VC (Lighthouse Seed Fund backed by the Czech ESIF Fund of Funds; Fund II started 2024); led Ranketta's pre-seed (Nov 2025) and joined Merchantee's seed extension (Jun 2026).

evidence.quote: B2B Software of various verticals, Fintech, AI
Lighthouse Ventures invests in European and US based startups.
Kolo vedl fond Reflex Capital za účasti Czech Founders VC a Lighthouse Ventures.
The funding round was led by Lighthouse Ventures, with participation from Gi21 Capital.

analyst_notes: Website is lhv.vc (lighthouseventures.cz does not resolve). Focus, ticket ('From €200k to €1m' investment in a single startup), stage ('Idea / Seed', mapped to pre_seed + seed) and geography ('Europe and US') are labels in the homepage strategy block; the homepage also states '2024 - Start year of most recent Fund II' (fund size not published). The Lighthouse Seed Fund is backed by the Czech ESIF Fund of Funds (CZFoF) per the site; the EIF list of EIF-backed active funds names 'Lighthouse Seed Fund (Prague)' with manager Lighthouse Ventures GP s.r.o. Capital not disclosed (a directory lists USD 24m AUM - not used). Merchantee: CZK 30m extension of the 2024 CZK 15m seed round (CzechCrunch 2026-06-09; Nordic9/Raising.fi give EUR 1.8m in total). Ranketta: EUR 1m pre-seed led by Lighthouse. Fund vehicle IČO not identified in ARES (only the GP company).
